name: FilterCellsInExcelWorksheetNode
label: Filter Cells in Excel Worksheet
description: Applies a filter to a specified range of cells in the provided Excel worksheet.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: WorksheetInstance
fields.label: Worksheet Instance
fields.description: The Excel Worksheet on which to apply the filter.

selectOptions.label: Equals
selectOptions.description: Filters cells that equal the specified value.

selectOptions.label: Does Not Equal
selectOptions.description: Filters cells that do not equal the specified value.

selectOptions.label: Greater Than
selectOptions.description: Filters cells greater than the specified value.

selectOptions.label: Greater Than or Equal To
selectOptions.description: Filters cells greater than or equal to the specified value.

selectOptions.label: Less Than
selectOptions.description: Filters cells less than the specified value.

selectOptions.label: Less Than or Equal To
selectOptions.description: Filters cells less than or equal to the specified value.

selectOptions.label: Contains
selectOptions.description: Filters cells containing the specified text.

selectOptions.label: Does Not Contain
selectOptions.description: Filters cells not containing the specified text.

selectOptions.label: Is Between
selectOptions.description: Filters cells between two specified values.

selectOptions.label: Clear Filter
selectOptions.description: Clears the existing filter from the range.

fields.name: Column
fields.label: Column
fields.description: The column letter or number on which to apply the filter.

fields.name: StartRow
fields.label: Start Row
fields.description: The starting row of the range to filter.

fields.name: EndRow
fields.label: End Row
fields.description: The ending row of the range to filter. If 0, uses the last row with data.

fields.name: StartColumn
fields.label: Start Column
fields.description: The starting column of the range.

fields.name: EndColumn
fields.label: End Column
fields.description: The ending column of the range.

fields.name: FilterValue2
fields.label: Filter Value 2
fields.description: The second value for range filters (between two values).
